user.title: Larnitech controller
user.description: Connect to a Larnitech controller over its local API (API2). The key is in LT Setup → Plugins → Home Assistant (or Security → Show API key).

data_description.host: IP address of the controller, e.g. 192.168.1.111, or SERIAL.in.larnitech.com for remote access
data_description.port: 2041 on the local network, 8443 for remote access via in.larnitech.com

reauth_confirm.title: Update API key
reauth_confirm.description: The controller rejected the API key. Enter the current key from LT Setup.

error.cannot_connect: Cannot connect to the controller. Check address, port and that the API is enabled.
error.invalid_auth: The controller rejected the API key.

data_description.ignored_types: Elements of these types are not added to Home Assistant.
data_description.export_entities: These entities become Larnitech elements: they appear in the Larnitech app and can be used in Larnitech scripts and Blockly. Commands from Larnitech control them here.

set_status.name: Set status
set_status.description: Send a raw status to a Larnitech element.

reload_devices.name: Reload elements
reload_devices.description: Reload the element list from the controller (after editing the project in LT Setup).
